caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate silver coffee pot placed centrally on a plain background. The coffee pot is highly detailed with intricate decorative patterns, including a finial at the top of the lid, elaborate floral and scroll motifs on the spout, handle, and the upper edge of the body. The handle is large, curving upwards and outwards, matching the elaborate design of the spout which also curves outward. The body of the pot is rounded, with prominent highlights and shaded areas indicating its reflective metallic surface. The vessel rests on a stepped, circular base with horizontal bands and similar detailed patterns as found elsewhere on the pot. The entire composition is rendered in monochromatic tones, predominantly using shades of gray and light brown, consistent with pencil or graphite drawing. At the lower left corner, the words “SILVER COFFEE POT,” “AMERICAN WING,” “Room L IV,” and “Metrop. Museum” are written in pencil. A signature, “Vincent Canova,” is located in the lower right corner. The drawing is bordered by a simple rectangular line.
title: Silver Teapot
